title: Cross-survey consistency: SDSS/eBOSS DR16 BAO vs DESI DR2 BAO under flat LCDM
stage: preregistration (no fit output of this problem has been produced or inspected)

model.name: flat LCDM, BAO-only
model.E_of_z: sqrt(Om*(1+z)^3 + 1 - Om)  (radiation neglected, <0.1% at z<=2.33; massive neutrinos absorbed into Om)
model.observables: DM/rd = (c/(100 h rd)) * int_0^z dz'/E ; DH/rd = c/(100 h rd E(z)) ; DV/rd = (z DM^2 DH)^(1/3)/rd ; c = 299792.458 km/s
model.sampler: emcee (32 walkers, >= 5000 steps, burn-in 1000; convergence: integrated autocorrelation time * 50 < chain length)
model.reported_summary: posterior mean +- std (DESI convention, 2503.14738 Sec. V); MAP also reported
model.two_independent_prediction_codes: astropy FlatLambdaCDM (Tcmb0=0) and a hand-coded scipy.integrate.quad implementation; required relative agreement < 1e-4 on every data point

components.form: chi2 table on alpha in [0.8005,1.1985] (399 pts, linspace); alpha = (DV/rd)/4.29720761315; logL = -chi2/2 via cubic spline; outside bounds -> -inf
1D (DV/rd, likelihood) table on [14.878, 22.275]; logL = ln(L) via cubic spline; outside -> -inf
2D (DM/rd, DH/rd, likelihood ratio) grid; ln L via RectBivariateSpline kx=ky=3; explicit bounds check -> -inf outside
same as Lya auto; treated as independent of auto (2007.08991 p.14)

gaussian_summary_variant.purpose: documented sensitivity variant + basis of the positive control; NOT the baseline
gaussian_summary_variant.Gaussian_pieces: DR12, DR16 LRG, QSO files as distributed

excluded_files.desi_2024_eboss_gaussian_bao_Lya_GCcomb_: DESI DR1 + eBOSS combined Lya (values = 2404.03002 eqs. 3.3-3.4); contains DESI data -> would combine surveys
excluded_files.sdss_DR12Consensus_bao.dat + BAO_consens: z=0.61 bin double-counts eBOSS LRG volume
excluded_files.desi_2024_* (DR1): superseded by and a subset of DR2

datasets.noted_file_vs_table_differences: DR12 cov file sigma(DH,0.38)=0.73 vs Table III 0.76; sigma(DM,0.51)=0.204 vs 0.21. The file is used.

targets.name: SDSS_Om
targets.source: arXiv:2007.08991 Table IV (BAO, flat LCDM): Omega_DE = 0.701 +0.017/-0.015 -> Om = 1-Omega_DE = 0.299 +0.015/-0.017; symmetric 0.016 also quoted by arXiv:2404.03002 Sec. 4.1

targets.name: SDSS_hrd_Mpc
targets.status: secondary-sourced; not found in fetched pages of 2007.08991; pass/fail on it is reported but flagged

qualitative_targets.name: DESI_DR2_vs_SDSS_consistency
qualitative_targets.source: arXiv:2503.14738 abstract ('consistent with DESI DR1 and SDSS'); Sec. III.C.2 (max 1.49 sigma alpha_iso, 1.69 sigma alpha_AP, KS p=0.39 / 0.15; LRG2 DM 1.5-2.6 sigma); Sec. VI after eq. (17)
qualitative_targets.status: verified primary, qualitative; no published (Om, hrd) tension number exists

tolerance_justification: Same data vectors/likelihood files as the published analyses, so only sampler/prior/summary differences remain: eBOSS sampled (Om, H0, Ob) in CosmoMC 'background' parameterization, DESI used Cobaya+CAMB with radiation/neutrinos; we neglect radiation (<0.1% in E(z)). The prior DR1 exercise (LL.md Sec. 11d) reproduced DESI DR1 at 0.07/0.11 sigma with the same approach. 0.5 sigma is loose enough for prior/parameterization effects on the non-Gaussian SDSS posterior and tight enough to catch a wrong file, redshift, or rs rescaling (each of which shifts parameters by >~1 sigma).

success_criteria.reproduction: |fit - published| / sigma_published < 0.5 for SDSS_Om, DESI_DR2_Om, DESI_DR2_hrd (primary); SDSS_hrd checked at 0.5 sigma but flagged secondary
success_criteria.tension: N_sigma (eq. 18 statistic, 2 dof, independent-survey assumption) < 2.0, matching DESI's 'no significant discrepancy'. Also report 1D differences, the SDSS (Om,hrd) correlation actually found, and the posterior parameter-shift cross-check.
success_criteria.literature_expectation_not_a_criterion: From published means/errors only: 1D 0.083 sigma (Om), 0.765 sigma (hrd); 2D 0.32-1.56 sigma over unpublished SDSS corr in [-0.95,0.95] (0.43 at -0.5, 0.74 at -0.8, 1.10 at -0.9).
success_criteria.interpretation_rule: N_sigma is a LOWER bound w.r.t. survey overlap (positive cross-survey correlation, e.g. C~0.57 for LRG2 vs eBOSS LRG per 2503.14738, would increase it). N_sigma >= 2 is reported as a failed replication of DESI's claim, not hidden.

positive_control.name: injected-parameter recovery on synthetic Gaussian data
positive_control.procedure: For each dataset (SDSS Gaussian-summary variant, DESI DR2), set the data vector to the model prediction at injected (Om, hrd) = (0.2975, 101.54) and add noise drawn from the dataset covariance (numpy default_rng seed 20260927). N = 200 realizations, fit by MAP + Fisher/Laplace errors (emcee on a subset of 20).

pass_thresholds.coverage_1sigma: fraction of realizations with injected value inside +-1 sigma in [0.60, 0.76] for each parameter
pass_thresholds.tension_calibration: SDSS-like and DESI-like synthetic sets drawn from the same injected parameters: median N_sigma < 1.0 and KS test of PTE vs Uniform(0,1) p > 0.01
pass_thresholds.noiseless: zero-noise data recover injected parameters to < 1e-3 relative

positive_control.naming: synthetic_/injected_ prefixes only (no mock_/dummy_ outside tests/)

instrument_check_grid_likelihoods.purpose: LL.md Sec. 1 applied to the new grid-likelihood code (no cosmology involved)
instrument_check_grid_likelihoods.procedure: for each interpolated table, locate the peak and the 68% interval (1D: Delta(-2lnL)=1; 2D: marginal widths and correlation from the normalised grid) and compare with the published summary
instrument_check_grid_likelihoods.pass_thresholds: |location - reference| < 0.1 sigma_ref and |width/sigma_ref - 1| < 0.15 for every table (Lya widths: published values include a fastMC correction, so width tolerance for Lya is 0.25; correlation |d rho| < 0.1)
instrument_check_grid_likelihoods.paired_negative: dropping the MGS rs_rescale 4.29720761315 (i.e. treating the table as DV/rd directly) must FAIL the MGS location check

negative_controls.wrong_model_no_Lambda: Einstein-de Sitter (Om=1, fixed) best fit over hrd must raise chi2 (or -2 lnL) by > 25 relative to flat-LCDM best fit on EACH real dataset
negative_controls.scrambled_covariance_must_fail: DESI DR2: swap DM/DH values within each anisotropic bin (e.g. Lya 38.99 <-> 8.63) keeping the covariance: chi2_min/dof must exceed 3. Also: DESI covariance scaled by 1/25 (errors /5): chi2_min/dof must exceed 3.
negative_controls.scrambled_covariance_report_only: random row/column permutation of the Gaussian SDSS pieces' covariances (numpy default_rng seed 20260927): outcome reported, not a pass/fail gate (a permutation can lower chi2 by construction)
negative_controls.injected_scale_shift: multiply every DESI DR2 distance ratio (DV, DM, DH) and its sigma by s = 0.93 (equivalent to hrd -> hrd/0.93 at fixed Om) and refit: DESI-vs-SDSS N_sigma must exceed 3. Literature-only expectation (prereg_inputs.json): min over SDSS corr in [-0.95,0.95] = 5.44 sigma, so failure to exceed 3 indicates a pipeline error.
negative_controls.combination_guard: code must refuse (raise) if any DESI file is loaded into the SDSS likelihood (tested by passing the excluded DESI+eBOSS Lya file)

amendments.note: Before any fit of this problem was run: (a) injected-shift negative control changed from 'DM x 1.03' (runs along the DESI degeneracy, not guaranteed > 3 sigma) to 'all ratios x 0.93' with closed-form expectation computed in prereg_inputs.py; (b) SDSS covariance permutation demoted to report-only, deterministic DESI DM/DH swap and cov/25 kept as must-fail; (c) grid-likelihood instrument check added with paired negative; (d) qualitative DESI consistency claim moved out of numeric 'targets' into 'qualitative_targets'.

cross_checks: two independent prediction codes agree < 1e-4 relative
grid-search chi2 minimum within 0.1 sigma of MAP for each dataset
baseline (grid likelihoods) vs Gaussian-summary variant: report the shift in SDSS (Om, hrd) in units of sigma
planned_outputs: formal/ANSE/BAO_TensionStatistic.lean (1D Gaussian tension symmetric & nonnegative; diagonal chi2 >= 0 and = 0 iff equal; pinned imports; in-file #print axioms)
p_success_rationale: DESI DR2 reproduction is near-certain (Gaussian, same pipeline as the successful DR1 exercise). Main risk: SDSS grid-likelihood handling (MGS alpha rescaling, ELG/Lya interpolation/bounds) and prior/parameterization differences vs CosmoMC; SDSS hrd target is secondary-sourced. The tension criterion (<2 sigma) is very likely given the literature band 0.32-1.56 sigma.
